rag.content:
lemma lt_last_iff_ne_last {a : Fin (n + 1)} : a < last n ↔ a ≠ last n := by
  simp [Fin.lt_iff_le_and_ne, le_last]

lemma mem_pair {a b c : α} : a ∈ [b, c] ↔ a = b ∨ a = c := by
  rw [mem_cons, mem_singleton]

namespace WickContraction

open FieldSpecification HepLean.List

variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification} {n : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n)
informal_statement: Given a Wick contraction \( c \) of order \( n \) and an element \( a \) of the set \( c.1 \), the second field associated with \( c \), denoted \( c.\text{sndFieldOfContract}(a) \), is an element of the set \( a.1 \).
informal_proof:
We start by applying the lemma `finset_eq_fstFieldOfContract_sndFieldOfContract`, which states that the first and second fields of a contraction are equal. This allows us to rewrite the goal as showing that \( c.\text{fstFieldOfContract}(a) \) is an element of \( a.1 \).

Next, we simplify this rewritten goal using basic properties of set membership and equality, thereby confirming that \( c.\text{sndFieldOfContract}(a) \) is indeed an element of \( a.1 \).

id.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_mem
id.content:
@[simp]
lemma sndFieldOfContract_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.sndFieldOfContract a ∈ a.1 := by
  rw [finset_eq_fstFieldOfContract_sndFieldOfContract]
  simp
